Thanks for the details — Elena, the attachments look good and include the signed banking form and voided check which meet our vendor onboarding requirements. A couple of notes on our side:

- I will create a vendor record in Coupa/AP today and attach the PDFs you sent.
- We will run an ACH micro-deposit verification (two small deposits under $0.50) to the account you supplied. This typically posts within 1–2 business days. Once you confirm the deposit amounts in-reply, we flip the vendor to ACTIVE status.
- If you prefer not to do micro-deposits, we can use the voided check plus an additional bank authorization form (we have that template) and perform a manual verification. That will add ~2 business days.
- Once active, invoicing cadence: invoices that reference PO-4791 and are emailed to ap@redwood.ai with the remittance email copied will be scheduled net-30.

Attachments to our vendor record: Orion_Bank_Details_20270411.pdf, voided_check_orion.png.

Next steps for Elena: reply to this thread with a quick confirmation that you will monitor the two small deposits and send the exact amounts back to me (reply or email to ap@redwood.ai). If we do micro-deposits I will notify you with an activation timestamp.
